summary: Standing 80-foot Aermotor LS-40 tower at an active Tennessee Division of Forestry site in Lawrence County; no build date or builder found, so the record is thin.

events.note: Register records a site visit dated November 26, 2022
Registered August 9, 2023 as US 1761, TN 65; nominated by Jason Johns

evidence.supports: administered by the Tennessee Division of Forestry
administered by the Tennessee Division of Forestry

evidence.quote: This is an active forestry site.
The tower is a 80ft Aermotor LS-40.

evidence.supports: inventory ID LWT002 in Lawrence County
inventory figure for the site is 1004 feet
inventory lists the tower as standing

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register gives 1,009 ft (308 m), close to the record's 307.5 m. The inventory's 1004 feet differs by about five feet; the record keeps the Register figure.

notes_for_editor: Two sources only, and neither gives a build date or builder. The Register page has no build field, and its only dates are the November 26, 2022 site visit and the August 9, 2023 registration. The Aermotor LS-40 model is the Register's claim; a web search found no independent record of the builder, so the story attributes the model to the Register. A 2015 consultant study of Tennessee Division of Forestry towers from 1933 to 1975 was mentioned in search results and may cover this tower; it was not read. Access and visiting rules are not in the sources, so access is omitted from facts. The inventory's standing label carries no check date. No photos added.
